environment.description: Docker container running python:3.11-slim with Flask app, deployed on EC2 instance. Container runs as root with default Docker seccomp profile. Network: public ALB forwarding to container port 8080. No additional middleware or filtering. Container filesystem is read-write with /opt/analyzers containing symlink to /usr/local/bin.

config.capabilities: default docker caps (includes CAP_SETUID, CAP_SETGID, CAP_NET_RAW)
